prompt:
Refine the approved reference single pitch slide into one exceptional stage-ready 16:9 startup pitch slide for the same product, now named Physical Impact. Use the attached slide as the exact visual direction: white background, generous whitespace, deep navy and petrol typography, mint accents, refined prepared-response product panel, very light borders. This is a copy-and-positioning refinement, not a new art direction. Flat slide image, approximately 1920x1080 landscape, no browser chrome or outer device. All text English, precisely spelled, crisp and readable from a stage. Keep it airy. No photos, glowing effects, 3D, robots, busy diagrams or dense fine print.

TOP LEFT BRAND: "Physical Impact" with one small mint angled mark. Remove every occurrence of AdaptOps and any A/B/C corner badge. Under brand, a modest clear descriptor: "A headless agent for physical operations."

LEFT MAIN HERO: large bold headline on 2-3 clean lines:
"Adapt as fast as your market changes."
Supporting paragraph:
"An agent that knows your business, works through your tools and uses market intelligence to coordinate a response and execute the actions you approve."
Then three brief outcomes, with good spacing:
"Keep production and projects moving."
"Protect commitments. Capture new demand."

RIGHT MAIN PRODUCT IDEA: a calm prepared-response panel, not a fake photograph or claimed screenshot. The panel heading:
"Your next response is ready"
Three short rows:
"What changed" with "Supply disruption and new demand"
"What it means for us" with "Protect current deliveries. Qualify the opportunity."
"Coordinated response" with compact roles "Procurement", "Operations", "Sales", "Finance"
Clear main button "Review & approve"
Continuation row "Execute → Verify → Remember"
Small light chips beneath panel: "Your tools", "Company knowledge", "Market intelligence"
A short caption outside the panel says "Works through your existing tools." Avoid a complex orbit. This product illustration communicates the received product vision. Do not add named vendor logos, ready-made connector badges or numerical outcomes.

BOTTOM: one clean row of three evenly spaced text columns with thin vertical rules:
1. Label "WHO IT'S FOR"
Text "Teams that buy, make, move and sell physical goods."
Smaller final line "First: timber, steel and construction materials."
2. Label "WHY NOW"
Text "Critical information arrives too late. Missing materials stall production, deliveries and projects."
3. Label "FIRST USERS"
Text "Targeted outreach to operations and procurement leaders. Start with one critical supply workflow, then expand across sites and teams."

LAST THIN STRIP at bottom, visually quieter than marketing promise, legible:
"Working core: tool-driven planning · human approval · durable decisions on Aiven."
This proof line describes received core capabilities only. Do not visually claim the illustrated full execution loop is already verified. Do not add a successful executed action receipt, a real connector, a profit number, a time-saving metric, customers or traction.
No "synthetic", "test", "demo", benchmark panels, funding, pricing or build warnings on the slide. Keep exact copy concise and readable. The white/navy/petrol/mint approved DA is paramount.
